meta.name: graph-ingest
meta.description: Use when the user brings an external source worth keeping — a URL, a paper, a tweet/thread, a blog post, a docs page — and wants it pulled into the second brain. Fetches the source into the git-ignored capture inbox, admits it to the committed wiki through the admission policy, then refreshes the knowledge graph so it joins the rest of your thinking. Trigger on "/graph-ingest", "ingest this url", "add this paper to my knowledge", "add this tweet/page to my knowledge", "capture this source".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把外部信息抓取到知识库并更新知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常从网页、论文、推文中收集信息并想结构化存储
copy.tagline_en: Fetch external sources into your knowledge base and refresh the graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often collect info from web pages, papers, or tweets and want structured storage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能抓取你给的网址、论文、推文等外部资料，先存入临时收件箱，再经脱敏和检查后加入知识库，最后更新知识图谱，让新内容与已有知识关联。
howto.when: 当你提供值得保存的外部链接（如网址、论文、推文等），或说出“保存这个”、“添加到我的知识”等指令时触发。

say.text: 把这篇论文添加到我的知识库。
say.note: Claude 会抓取论文并处理。

say.text: 保存这个网址到我的第二大脑。
say.note: Claude 会抓取并存入知识库。

say.text: 把这条推文加入我的知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会抓取并更新图谱。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch external sources (URLs, papers, tweets, etc.) you provide, store them in a temporary inbox, then de-identify and lint them before admitting to the wiki, and finally refresh the knowledge graph to link the new content with existing knowledge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an external source worth keeping (e.g., URL, paper, tweet) or say phrases like "save this", "add this to my knowledge".

say_en.text: Add this paper to my knowledge base.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and process the paper.

say_en.text: Save this URL to my second brain.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and ingest the URL.

say_en.text: Ingest this tweet into my knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and update the graph.
